Texts.SignIn:ApiIntro: You're signing in to Swagger UI to try the OpenTMS API. The token you get belongs to the organisation you choose.
Texts.SignIn:Title: Sign in
Texts.SignIn:EmailUnknown: There is no account with this e-mail address.
Texts.SignIn:Unavailable: Signing in is not possible right now. Please try again later.
Texts.SignIn:TenantStepText: Your account exists in more than one organisation. Type part of the organisation's name to continue.
Texts.SignIn:TenantHintNone: None of your organisations matches this.
Texts.SignIn:TenantHintAmbiguous: More than one of your organisations matches; type more.
Texts.SignIn:TenantSelectionExpired: This sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
Texts.SignIn:TenantAmbiguous: More than one of your organisations matches. Type more of the name.
Texts.SignIn:TenantNotFound: None of your organisations has this name.
Texts.SignIn:ForgotText: Enter your e-mail address. We'll send you a link to choose a new password. Is your account in more than one organisation? Then you get an e-mail for each.
Texts.SignIn:ForgotNotSent: We could not send an e-mail for this address. Ask your administrator to send you a link to choose a new password.
Texts.SignIn:LinkSentText: We've sent you an e-mail with a link to choose a new password. The link can be used once and is valid for 24 hours. Until then your current password keeps working.
Texts.SignIn:LinkSentHint: No e-mail after a few minutes? Look in your junk mail folder, or ask your administrator.
Texts.SignIn:NewPasswordText: Choose the password you'll sign in with from now on.
Texts.SignIn:NewPasswordRequiredFirst: Your administrator asks you to choose a new password before you continue.
Texts.SignIn:PasswordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same.
Texts.SignIn:LinkInvalidText: The link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one: you get it by e-mail.
Texts.SignIn:PasswordSetText: Sign in with your e-mail address and your new password.
Texts.Shell:EmptyAppText: This app is a stub — features arrive through the department pipeline.
Texts.RecordNotFound: This record does not exist or is no longer available.
